Question: How do I get a duplicate SIM if mine is lost or damaged?

Answer: Visit any NovaTel Experience Store with valid photo ID matching your KYC record, or verify identity via video-KYC in the app under SIM Services > Replace SIM. A duplicate SIM is issued instantly in most cases; your number and remaining balance/plan carry over unchanged.
